summary: MBX Biosciences filed an 8-K furnishing a press release and presentation regarding an obesity portfolio update, including initial Phase 1 data for MBX 4291 and nomination of MBX 5765. The filing is a routine business update under Items 7.01 and 8.01, with no M&A, capital markets, or control event. The registrant acts solely as the issuer providing operational and clinical pipeline information. No special-situation category applies; this is a standard periodic disclosure.
